title: AMD Po3 with Live Edge Stats [WillyAlgoTrader]
input_contract: Finite OHLC with timezone-aware increasing bar-open index; completed bars only, optional as_of enforces availability. Minimum tick is explicit. Config validates source input ranges. Session boundaries must align to chart bars.
required_extra_inputs: session timezone/settings; exact HTF close/EMA observations only if HTF bias enabled
capture_route: Private pinned-source instrumentation: source renders boxes/labels/table, no plot series. Expose existing state and flags after source updates; do not turn drawing coordinates into entry times.

title: Volume Footprint: Measuring by Math & Geometry
input_contract: Finite repository OHLC and finite nonnegative Volume; unique increasing timezone-aware bar-open index; explicit fixed-minute duration and optional as_of reject incomplete/future bars. Original source min/max parameters enforced. Main calculation uses caller's fixed history origin.

source_defaults.tick_size: required explicit syminfo.mintick value; never inferred

upstream_plots.code: plot(engBuy,           "Buy Volume",         color = COL_FWD, display = display.data_window, editable = false)
plot(engSell,          "Sell Volume",        color = COL_REV, display = display.data_window, editable = false)
plot(engBuy + engSell, "Total Volume",       display = display.data_window, editable = false)
plot(buyShare * 100,   "Buy Share %",        color = COL_FWD, display = display.data_window, editable = false, precision = 1)
plot(sellShare * 100,  "Sell Share %",       color = COL_REV, display = display.data_window, editable = false, precision = 1)
plot(profResidual,  "Residual PPM",      display = display.data_window, editable = false, precision = 4)
plot(profTilt,      "Balance Tilt %",    display = display.data_window, editable = false, precision = 1)
plot(pocDashLevel,  "Dashboard POC", display = display.data_window, editable = false)
plot(pocChartLevel, "Chart POC",     display = display.data_window, editable = false)

required_extra_inputs: intrabar engine: exact TradingView ta/14 up/down totals and observed_at; native engine: native footprint rows/provider schema
capture_route: Unmodified CSV exports Buy Volume, Sell Volume, Total Volume, Buy Share %, Sell Share %, Residual PPM, Balance Tilt %, Dashboard POC, Chart POC. Engine volumes are historical series. Dashboard/profile are barstate.islast: collect separate Bar Replay terminal snapshots with complete history. VA/imbalance/level rows need separately reviewed snapshot serialization.
scope_limit: Geometric is modeled price-action volume; intrabar requires exact external totals. Native footprint is unsupported by current Python port and cannot be admitted by geometric parity.

title: Setup Scanner [GBB]
input_contract: Finite OHLC with timezone-aware bar-open index, completed bars only. Volume can be missing/NaN per source but cannot be negative/infinite. Source numeric limits validated; three target multiples need not be ordered because source does not enforce ordering.

upstream_plots.code: plot(useOrb and inSess and orDone ? orH : na, "OR high", color.new(cForm, 30), 1, plot.style_linebr)
plot(useOrb and inSess and orDone ? orL : na, "OR low",  color.new(cForm, 30), 1, plot.style_linebr)
plotshape(markLong,  "Long marker",  shape.triangleup,   location.belowbar, cLong,  size = size.tiny)
plotshape(markShort, "Short marker", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, cShort, size = size.tiny)
alertcondition(anyLong,  "Any long setup",  "Setup Scanner: long signal")
alertcondition(anyShort, "Any short setup", "Setup Scanner: short signal")

minimum_python_event_outputs: per-setup raw/accepted long and short signals
required_extra_inputs: exact exported ta.vwap observation or exact exchange reset flags; session start/timezone/opening-range settings
capture_route: OR high/OR low and Long marker/Short marker export directly. Private instrumentation is required to separate six setup raw signals from accepted signals and reference-trade outcomes; the two generic markers alone do not validate the full adapter.
required_observed_cases: each of six setup branches in both directions
